text:
sarah-support: Heads up — ACME Corp's invoice INV-2026-3345 (PO: PO-8891) is blocked. They're requesting Net-45 deferral; payment method card on file declined. Need decision from finance + legal. @raj-finance can you advise?

mike-sales: We negotiated Net-45 during the pilot onboarding. They submitted the PO late, billing attempted the card and got a decline. Sales would like a temporary credithold so the pilot isn't interrupted.

billing-bot: billing-bot: Payment attempt failed for INV-2026-3345 — decline code 05 (card declined). Retries left: 3. Next retry in ~1h. Amount: $32,450.00 USD.

raj-finance: Need signed PO that matches billing entity, plus tax forms (W9/ VAT as applicable). Standard policy: Net-30 by default; Net-45 requires manager approval and a signed addendum. What's the revenue profile here and risk?

sarah-support: FYI ARR ~0 (pilot), one-off invoice for implementation. Customer says Net-45 is procurement requirement. They also asked whether we can split invoice into 2 payments. I have screenshot of decline and a scanned PO.

linda-legal: Legal can allow Net-45 conditionally if we get a signed SOW addendum and a billing contact on file. I'll prepare a short addendum template. @mike-sales please confirm the signing contact and explain split-payment terms.

mike-sales: Contact is julie.h@acme.com (Procurement Lead). I'll request signature today. They prefer arrears (post-delivery) but need flexibility for procurement cycles. Split-pay: they asked 50/50 up front vs completion — need legal signoff.

tom-ops: From platform side no service blocks. If finance grants temporary credit, we can flip a billing flag to prevent auto-cancel. Ops request: open internal ticket to track the flag and expiry date.

sarah-support: Action items: 1) Mike to obtain signed addendum + tax docs; 2) Raj to approve conditional Net-45 credit line (recommend cap $40k) or instruct finance hold; 3) Tom to set billing flag once approved. Everyone pls ack.

raj-finance: :thumbsup: I can provisionally approve a $40k conditional credit hold pending signed addendum and tax docs. Note: if customer is EU entity we need reverse-charge VAT certificate; otherwise W9/EIN suffices. I'll open approval ticket and mark it pending documents.

mike-sales: They're US (Acme US) — EIN present on PO. I'll attach it. I'll push for signature today.

billing-bot: billing-bot: Credit hold placed on INV-2026-3345 (reason: pending docs) by @raj-finance. Auto-retries paused.

sarah-support: Thanks — moving to a private thread to collect the docs and update customer. I'll update ticket #TKT-7521 when we have the signed addendum.

-- end of thread --
